issue.title: Axe j/k benchmark captures Agents-tab samples under load
issue.description: Proposed by sase-17m.5.1.6.4 note #2. During agent-session cutover verification, test_bench_axe_jk failed its exact tab-set assertion with Agents samples mixed into the Axe window. The same failure appeared on the post-epic tree and pre-epic 02c4b029a under the same host load, so it is not caused by the rename. Investigate the sample-window boundary around before = len(_read_samples(_perf_jsonl)) and isolate the Axe measurements without relaxing the performance budget.

task_type_fields.impact: The Axe j/k performance gate fails before latency evaluation and cannot validate its p95 budget reliably.
task_type_fields.repro: Run pytest -s -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py under shared-host load; compare pre-epic 02c4b029a. The assertion at bench_tui_jk_panes.py:98 can see both agents and axe tab samples.
